rationale: Justice Thomas, as the senior Justice in the majority and the one most focused on Felder/Howlett and Supremacy Clause first principles, is best positioned to assign and keep a cross-ideological majority together around a narrow as-applied preemption holding. The most likely separate writings are a Roberts/Kavanaugh dissent emphasizing vehicle/remedial limits and one or more concurrences (especially Gorsuch or Kagan/Barrett) sharpening the scope of the preemption rule and its interaction with federal remedial limits like Cummings.
